name: NumberToConvert
label: NumberToConvert
description: A numeric value to convert to text.

name: DecimalPlaces
label: DecimalPlaces
description: The number of decimal places that will be included before truncation. Zeros can also be added to the end to pad the text in this way.

name: UseThousandsSeparator
label: UseThousandsSeparator
description: Specify whether or not to use punctuation as a thousand separator.
